definitions.paired_share: share of families whose twin scores strictly lower (more trustworthy) than its malicious partner
definitions.record_basis: a record is flagged when any sentence scores strictly above the threshold; paired share compares the records' maximum probabilities
definitions.released_test: leak-excluded as evaluation leak-excluded: full, minus_verbatim, minus_near; mean and sd over seeds
definitions.spread: mean over seeds; sd is the population sd over seeds; fold_sd is the population sd over the per-fold values of every seed
definitions.target_basis: the target sentence alone; twin and malicious records only

bow_baseline.note: twin vs malicious only, no controls; deterministic, one value per figure
